Note that these results concern the restricted minimization problem over lattices, while Gersho’s
conjecture asks whether the minimizing lattice is also optimal among all non-lattice configurations,
which remains open for d ≥ 3. In dimension 3, numerical evidence indicates that the normalized second moment of the BCC lattice is close to the theoretical lower bound on C2,3 [GL00,
